openQuestions.text: RTL scripts (Arabic, Hebrew) and vertical writing are not supported for editing; planned as FNT-18 (P8).
fit=True (FNT-10) fragments a span's texttrace into one span per character, so a second edit can no longer find that text as one span. fit defaults to False until this is fixed.
FNT-09 kerning reads only legacy 'kern' tables, not GPOS pair positioning, and no GSUB ligature substitution is attempted.
Editing a shape (EDT-09) is remove-then-redraw from get_drawings() data: blend modes, pattern/shading paints and optional-content membership are not carried over -- documented in engine/shapes.py.
Image crop (EDT-08) is refused for rotated/skewed placements; image and shape boxes in the UI skip near-full-page shapes (backgrounds) so they can't swallow clicks.
Spell-check bundles only an en_US dictionary; the ignore list is per browser (localStorage), not a shared user dictionary.
Click-to-edit (UI-02) shows an approximation of the span's font family/weight/style while typing, not the document's own embedded font loaded as a browser @font-face (documented in web/README.md).

Only Windows is tested routinely (Python 3.14 via tools/gate.py, Python 3.11 via gate.py --python .venv311/...). Linux and macOS are exercised only by ci.yml's manual workflow_dispatch matrix, which costs Actions minutes: run it once before a release.
